method.notes: Analyzes training against soft (smoothed) target distributions. Cited for the mechanism that cross-entropy against soft targets is bounded below by the entropy of the target distribution itself — minimum CE = H(target) > 0. Applied to Run-2-XL: the road head trains on Change-9 geometry-derived SOFT pseudo-labels, so its train CE plateau at ~1.36 nats may be at/near an irreducible pseudo-label entropy floor rather than evidence of insufficient capacity. The floor has never been measured (probe P0b: log H(soft_target) per batch).

gap_analysis.whats_missing: Not a map-matching paper; methodology reference for the CE-floor argument.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Cited for the entropy-floor property of soft-target CE, central to the label-free signal-ceiling diagnosis.

uncertain: Paper's focus is label smoothing's effects on calibration/distillation; the entropy-floor property is elementary information theory the paper exemplifies rather than its headline claim.
